notes: For RT-09: M9 beat 1's 'A node is black exactly when θ fixes its root' is false as stated for decorations that break condition 2, for example A3 with nodes 1 and 2 black and τ the identity (θ(α1) = α2). It holds on every admissible pair checked (redteam/redteam-RT-08-p6-black-fixed.py). P6-RT-08-02 reports only the missing provenance.

Kostant attribution, for the owner. /history/ wraps 'The fuller attribution is to Bertram Kostant, with the game popularised by Allen Knutson and by Alexander Postnikov's course at MIT in 2017' as E13, so the release drops it. M1 beat 3 (phase 1) states 'it was popularised by Allen Knutson [Ele16] and by Alexander Postnikov's course at MIT [Che17]' unwrapped, and the release keeps it. Both are defensible (E13 concerns the wording of the attribution; Ele16 and Che17 are [S]), but the two pages treat one claim differently.

Word counts are not reported as a finding. Under the lens's literal Methods 5.9 (letter-digit runs on the visible KaTeX copy) M9 counts 1852 (A) and 2249 (B), because every symbol of a formula counts as a word. Counting each formula as one word gives 1760 (letter runs) or 1785 (the M9.spec rule). M8 counts 1804 under M9's rule with the links block included (M8.spec skips the links block after MERGE).

The /embed/<tool>/ routes render no footer, so a tool embedded elsewhere carries no licence statement (SPEC 7.9 'State both in the footer'). The plan (P6-A6 5.10) allows this, and MERGE's repair of the pages-6 test accepted it. Noted for the owner, not reported.

T13's quasi-split line says 'Its shadows are the averaged roots of the folding by τ'. The glossary names the averaged construction 'restricting the roots' and the orbit-sum construction 'folded board', and M9 says 'the averaged roots of module six'. This is a wording choice below the finding threshold.

M9 uses 'fired' once (beat 2) with no glossary link. P6-terms' rule links later uses of terms used at least twice on a page, so this is consistent with the shared spec. Recorded for the owner's reading of 8.4.
Credits in the release 1.0 build still says the content licence 'may change before the first release'. This may be stale if release 0.5 was tagged.
